SAATVIK INTERNATIONAL

Premium Healthy Snacking Solutions

1. About Our Company

Saatvik International is a growing trading and wholesale company specializing in premium-quality healthy snacks and innovative snacking solutions. We deal in a diverse range of products, including raw and flavoured makhana (fox nuts), jowar puffs, and other healthy snack categories.

Our focus is on providing quality products, reliable sourcing, competitive pricing, and consistent supply solutions to businesses across India and international markets.

We aim to bridge the gap between quality snack manufacturers and businesses by offering end-to-end B2B sourcing, bulk supply, and private-label solutions.

At Saatvik International, we believe in building long-term business relationships through product quality, transparency, reliability, and customer satisfaction.

2. What We Deal In – Our Product Range

Our product portfolio includes:

A. Makhana (Fox Nuts)

* Raw Makhana
* Premium Grade Makhana
* Roasted Makhana
* Flavoured Makhana
* Bulk Makhana Supply

B. Jowar Puffs

* Plain Jowar Puffs
* Flavoured Jowar Puffs
* Bulk Supply

C. Healthy Snacks

* Innovative and emerging healthy snack products
* Roasted and flavoured snack varieties
* Other value-added snacking products

Our product portfolio is continuously expanding to meet changing consumer preferences and market demands.

3. What We Do – Our Business Activities

Wholesale & Bulk Supply
We provide bulk quantities of healthy snack products to distributors, wholesalers, retailers, supermarket chains, corporate buyers, and other businesses.

Private Label Solutions
We help businesses launch their own snack brands by providing product sourcing, manufacturing coordination, customized packaging, and private-label supply solutions.

B2B Trading & Distribution
We connect manufacturers with businesses and provide efficient sourcing and supply solutions with a focus on quality, pricing, and timely delivery.

Customized Product Solutions
We work with business clients to understand their product requirements, flavour preferences, packaging needs, and quantity requirements.

Domestic & International Business
We aim to serve customers across India while developing business relationships with international buyers and importers.

4. Our Target Customers

* Distributors and wholesalers
* Supermarkets and retail chains
* Grocery and FMCG businesses
* Food brands and startups
* Private-label brand owners
* Corporate buyers
* Exporters and international importers
* HORECA and institutional buyers

5. Why Choose Saatvik International?

* Diverse range of healthy snack products

6. Our Vision

To establish Saatvik International as a trusted name in the healthy snacking industry by delivering quality products, creating strong business partnerships, and expanding our presence across domestic and international markets.

7. Our Mission

To make quality healthy snacking products accessible to businesses through reliable sourcing, competitive pricing, innovative product offerings, and dependable supply solutions.
